writes.name: billy_create_daybook_transaction
writes.title: Create journal entry
writes.description: Create a manual journal entry (kassekladde) for postings that have no invoice or bill behind them: reclassifications, accruals, dividend and equity entries. Accounts may be given by number. The entry must balance. Dry-runs by default, and creates a DRAFT unless state is 'approved', so nothing reaches the ledger until someone approves it in Billy. Not for bank lines: match those in Billy's bank reconciliation.

dryRun.description: Default true: return the exact request without sending it. Set false only after the dry run was reviewed.

daybookId.description: Daybook ID; defaults to the organisation's only daybook

currencyId.description: Currency; defaults to the organisation's base currency

state.description: Default draft; approve in Billy after review

side.description: Side this line posts to on `account`

amount.description: Amount; VAT-inclusive when taxRateId is set (Billy splits the VAT off)

taxRateId.description: Tax rate ID; omit for no VAT

contraAccount.description: Account number or ID for the opposite side. Makes the line balance on its own

paging.description: Pagination info; use `total`/`pageCount` to decide whether to page further

dryRun.description: True when nothing was sent to Billy

request.description: The request that would be sent (dry run only)

preview.description: Human-readable summary of the change, where the tool provides one
